QuiverAI | San Francisco / Remote (US, Europe) | Full-time

QuiverAI is training foundational AI models and building tools for vector design. We’re creating multimodal systems that generate editable SVGs and design assets from texts, images, and sketches. Come build with us!

We’re hiring across design, engineering, and research:

- Product Designer https://quiver.ai/careers/product-designer

- Backend Engineer, API Platform https://quiver.ai/careers/backend-engineer-api-platform

- Design Engineer https://quiver.ai/careers/design-engineer

- Platform Engineer, Reliability https://quiver.ai/careers/platform-reliability-engineer

- Product Engineer https://quiver.ai/careers/product-engineer

- AI Research Scientist https://quiver.ai/careers/ai-research-scientist

- ML Engineer https://quiver.ai/careers/ml-engineer

San Francisco or Remote (US, Europe) for most roles. Apply here: https://quiver.ai/careers
